ORDER ON REQUEST TO APPEAR BY TELEPHONE. THE REQUEST IS GRANTED.
EXHIBITS RECEIVED, FOR TELEPHONE APPEARANCE, AND FORWARDED -TO DEPT.506- TO BE LODGED WITH DOCKET AS TO PLAINTIFF RAMBERT, ELODIE RAMBERT, MARC

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-12-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO FEB-02-2021 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ELODIE RAMBERT AND MARC RAMBERT ARE PRESENT VIA TELEPHONIC APPEARANCE, COURTCALL. DEFENDANT CHRISTINE COATES IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT OF $1057. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE FEB-02-2021 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE OR THE AGREEMENT BROKEN. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. COMMISSIONER: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
